sections.title: New roofs for McAllen homes
paras: About 40% of McAllen homes were built before 1990, according to Census survey data (ACS 2024), and the median home dates to 1997. A shingle roof in this heat lasts roughly 20 to 25 years. Do the math and a large share of McAllen houses are on their second roof or due for one. Owners live in about 63% of those homes; the rest are rentals, where a roof also has to pass the next insurance renewal.

Age by itself is not a reason to replace. We look at the whole roof and the decking under it first. Widespread granule loss, leaks in more than one place, soft decking, or storm damage across a large part of the roof are what move a job from repair to replacement. If a repair would hold, we say so. See roof repair in McAllen for that side.

sections.title: Heat is what wears out a McAllen roof
paras: NOAA climate normals for the McAllen airport (1991 to 2020) show about 40 days a year at 100°F or hotter and 177 days at 90°F or hotter. The average high in August is 99.6°F. A dark roof in that sun gets far hotter than the air, every day, for half the year. Shingles dry out, the asphalt loses its oils, and the granules come loose.

That is why ventilation matters as much as the shingle. When an attic cannot let hot air out, the heat builds up under the roof deck and ages the shingles from below. During a replacement we check the intake and exhaust vents and can upgrade them, along with synthetic underlayment, so the new roof lasts as long as it should.

sections.title: What a McAllen roof replacement includes

cards.title: Full tear off
cards.body: The old roof comes off down to the decking. We do not lay new shingles over old ones.

cards.title: Decking check
cards.body: Rotted or water damaged decking found under the old roof is replaced and noted in your paperwork.

cards.title: Shingle choice
cards.body: CertainTeed, Owens Corning, or GAF. As a CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster we can offer stronger CertainTeed warranty coverage.

cards.title: Ventilation and underlayment
cards.body: Attic vents checked and upgraded where needed, with modern synthetic underlayment under the shingles.

cards.title: Written scope
cards.body: Materials, price, and timeline in writing before the first shingle comes off.

cards.title: New builds and additions
cards.body: We also roof new homes and additions in McAllen and coordinate with the builder or general contractor.

sections.title: Insurance and an older McAllen roof
paras: If your roof is older, your insurance company may already be asking about it. The Texas Department of Insurance says an insurer cannot refuse or drop a policy because of roof age alone, but it can look at the roof's condition. Some policies pay older roofs at actual cash value, meaning depreciation comes out of the claim.

When a storm causes the damage, the claim may cover much of a replacement. In May 2025 spotters reported hail up to 2 inches in north McAllen. TDI's roof replacement tips say to get more than one bid and never let a contractor waive your deductible, which is illegal in Texas. We agree with both. You can read more in our post on McAllen roof replacement timeline and insurance.

faqs.q: How much does a new roof cost in McAllen?
faqs.a: For a typical McAllen home, a full shingle replacement generally runs between $8,000 and $18,000. Roof size, pitch, the material coming off, and the shingle line you choose move the number. You get a written estimate before any work begins.

faqs.q: How long will the job take?
faqs.a: Most McAllen homes take one to three days, weather permitting. The timeline is in the written scope before we start.

faqs.q: My insurer wants a new roof before it renews. What do I do?
faqs.a: Get an inspection first so you know the roof's real condition. If it only needs repairs, a written report may be enough for your agent. If it needs replacing, we give you the scope and price in writing.

faqs.q: Can you put new shingles over my old roof?
faqs.a: We do a full tear off on our replacements. Taking the old roof off is the only way to see and fix the decking underneath.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for a new roof in McAllen?
faqs.a: McAllen uses the 2024 International Residential Code, and roofing is part of the city's residential permit application. McAllen Permits and Inspections is at (956) 681-1300 if you want to confirm for your address.

faqs.q: How do I get a replacement estimate in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We walk the roof, measure it, and give you a written estimate for free.
